summary: The first explicit-trajectory control-video build stopped before producing valid videos because the ImageGen clean plate had an odd 1672x941 resolution that libx264 rejected.
evidence: outputs/minimax-h3-action-controls/20260810T133800Z-explicit-trajectories-v1 contains the failed attempt directory, and the encoder reported height not divisible by 2 for 1672x941.
lessons: All camera-pixel waypoints and image assets must be normalized to one explicitly named even-sized source-camera frame before video encoding.
limitations: No usable control video was produced.
next_actions: Normalize the anchor, mask, and clean plate to camera:source_anchor_pixels at 1280x720 and rerun in a new directory.
